channel.name: Aakhir Kyun?
channel.niche: the surprising science and hidden engineering behind everyday things in India and around the world: trains, planes, roads, food, the body, animals and how things are made; why and how things really work, explained accurately in everyday Hindi
channel.audience: Hindi-speaking viewers in India aged 14-40, curious, scroll fast, no science background needed
channel.voice_tone: friendly, confident, curious, like an older sibling who loves science; never clickbait-false
channel.how_made: यह वीडियो कैसे बना: स्क्रिप्ट को AI tools की मदद से open research के आधार पर लिखा और fact-check किया गया है, आवाज़ AI voice की है, और editing open-source software से हुई है। कोई गलती दिखे तो comment में बताइए — जाँच कर सुधार करेंगे।
channel._note: Hindi version of Ever Thought Why? (built 16 Nov 2026 after the niche scan: a Hindi hidden-engineering channel started Sep 2026 reached 308K subscribers and a 1.57M median). The owner creates the channel and signs it in (STUDIO_CHANNEL=hi studio.py signin; secret TOKEN_JSON_HI).

voice.name: hi-IN-SwaraNeural
voice._note: ONE narrator per channel (16 Nov 2026, owner: two voices felt like an overheard conversation; a single consistent voice becomes the channel's identity). host/explainer only change delivery.
voice._engine_note: 17 Nov 2026, owner picked H6 (Swara) at +18% instead of +15%, reading Hinglish (Hindi with everyday English words, as people really talk). Chatterbox Hindi was rejected: it mumbles and is not always clear.

publish.timezone_note: 09:30 ET = 20:00 IST (India prime time), 02:30 ET = 13:00 IST (lunch)

animate._note: Manim labels use a Latin-only font; off until a Devanagari font is wired in
